item.title: Mockup Fragrance product spot, 15 s

turns.text:
Make a 15-second vertical 9:16 ad for my perfume, Mockup Fragrance. Use the attached bottle photo. Keep the bottle's shape, colour and label the same in every shot, and leave the box out.

Three shots, in this order:
1. The bottle alone on a light surface.
2. A hand picks up the bottle and sprays it, in a bathroom.
3. End card for the last 3 seconds: solid #3B1F6B background, white text "This one stays." and "Available 12 December".

No voice. Put light music under the whole video. Give me one finished video file.

item.nudge: Make as much of this as you can with the tools you have, and give me the closest thing to one finished file.
item.tests: Tests one product reference across shots, a hand with the product, an exact end card in the brand colour, a music bed with no speech, and one joined 15-second file.

answer_sheet.Bottle: The clear glass bottle with the grey cap and the MOCKUP FRAGRANCE label in the attached photo; leave the box out.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Shots: Bottle alone on a light surface; a hand picks it up and sprays it in a bathroom; end card for the last 3 seconds.
answer_sheet.End card: Solid #3B1F6B background, white text This one stays. and Available 12 December.
answer_sheet.Sound: Light music under the whole video; no voice.

must_haves: One playable 9:16 video file runs for 15 seconds, plus or minus 1 second.
Three shots appear in the requested order.
The bottle keeps its shape and colour in shots 1 and 2, the MOCKUP FRAGRANCE label stays readable, and the box does not appear.
A hand picks up the bottle and sprays it in a bathroom.
The last 3 seconds show the end card with the exact text on a solid background near #3B1F6B.
Light music is audible and there is no speech.

input.prompt: A luxury perfume commercial in vertical 9:16. Use the exact perfume bottle in the first-frame reference, maintaining its identical rectangular clear-glass silhouette, pale translucent liquid, square pale taupe cap, silver spray nozzle, and the original crisp black MOCKUP / FRAGRANCE label. No box or packaging anywhere. Exactly TWO shots with a clean hard cut at 6 seconds. 0.0-6.0 seconds: the bottle alone on a pale ivory surface, matching the reference, soft warm daylight, restrained slow push-in, elegant realistic glass highlights, bottle fully visible and label facing camera, no hand. 6.0-12.0 seconds: hard cut to a softly sunlit upscale cream bathroom vanity; the SAME bottle with precisely the same proportions, glass, liquid colour and original black label faces camera; one graceful adult hand picks up the bottle, lifts off its square cap to reveal its silver atomizer, presses the nozzle once, producing a delicate visible mist into the air. Anatomically accurate hand, natural realistic movement, no extra fingers, do not change bottle shape or label. 12.0-16.0 seconds: hold the bathroom shot steadily. No on-screen titles or subtitles. SOUNDTRACK: continuous light instrumental ambient music throughout all 16 seconds, delicate soft piano and airy warm synth pads, gentle relaxed pulse, understated luxury beauty-ad mood. ONLY instrumental music: absolutely no voice, speech, singing, whispers, dialogue or vocal sounds. Keep music smooth across the cut.
